questions.stem: The iterative formula $x_{n+1} = \frac{x_n^2 + 3}{4}$ with $x_0 = 1$. What is $x_1$?
What does it mean when an iterative formula 'converges'?

options.text: The values alternate between two numbers
Successive values get closer and closer to a fixed value
The formula stops working after a few iterations

questions.explanation: An iterative formula converges when successive iterations approach a fixed value (the limit). This limit is a solution to the equation formed by setting $x_{n+1} = x_n$.
